title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin surged eight point three percent to close at seventy five thousand four hundred fifty dollars as US trading wrapped, flipping fear and greed to seventy two greed. Hashrate held firm at eight hundred twelve point seven EH/s while the mempool backed up to eighty seven thousand transactions with fees at just two sat per vbyte. Block height ticked to nine hundred sixty three thousand three hundred seventy two. Key takeaway: momentum is building on solid fundamentals, not hype. Overnight watc
